scriptText:
I. STILL HERE

[[STAGING]]
[[INTENT]]
Create a cinematic psychological drama scene featuring @actor1 as Felix, a guilt-ridden survivor, and @actor2 as Samira, his silent companion, climbing a claustrophobic, rain-shrouded mountain path.
[[/INTENT]]

[[LOGIC]]
Maintain strict screen direction with the camera on the right side of the axis. Preserve the wet, dirty skin textures. Ensure match-on-action of Felix’s heavy, labored steps.
[[/LOGIC]]

[[AESTHETIC]]
- Visual: Desaturated slate-grays, bruised blues, dark moss greens. Heavy mist creates a closed-in, claustrophobic atmosphere.
- Lighting: Overcast, diffused, low-contrast daylight with wet highlights on skin and nylon.
- Wardrobe: Felix wearing a charcoal beanie, wire-frame glasses, wet mustard windbreaker, damp heavy jeans; Samira wearing a dark slate waxed jacket, dark cargo pants, wet French braid.
- Sound: Strictly diegetic. Low hiss of drizzle, wet boot squelches, heavy breathing, clicking trekking poles. No music.
[[/AESTHETIC]]

[[OPENING]]
[CAM] Low-angle MCU, tracking backward -> [BLOCK] Felix leads the climb frame-left, gasping for air, while Samira follows closely in soft focus frame-right -> [ACT] Felix struggles uphill
[[/OPENING]]
[[/STAGING]]

[<BRIEF>]
[CAM] MCU, tracking backward -> [BLOCK] Felix moves forward through dense mist, Samira walking behind him -> [ACT] Felix looks up-trail, his breathing shallow and labored -> [AUDIO] FELIX: "They keep telling me how lucky I am to still be here." -> [SFX] Heavy, wet wheezing.
[CAM] MS, side-angle, tracking uphill -> [BLOCK] Felix leads frame-left, leaning on a black trekking pole; Samira climbs behind him frame-right -> [ACT] Felix drags his wet leg forward, wincing -> [AUDIO] FELIX: "(Bitter laugh) Like staying alive... is some kind of prize I won." -> [SFX] Click of trekking pole against wet stone.
[CAM] OTS over Felix's shoulder -> [BLOCK] Samira centered, walking uphill in lockstep -> [ACT] Her cold-flushed face remains calm, her intense gaze fixed on him as she walks -> [AUDIO] FELIX (O.S.): "(Gasping gasp) But nobody warns you..." -> [ENV] Thick fog swirling around them.
[CAM] CU, tracking profile -> [BLOCK] Felix frame-left, Samira's face partially visible in the background frame-right -> [ACT] Felix slows his pace slightly but continues walking, turning his head toward her with wet glasses -> [AUDIO] FELIX: "...about the morning after. Or the year after." -> [SFX] Rain dripping off his beanie, ending in media res.
[</BRIEF>]

---

[[STAGING]]
[[INTENT]]
Create a psychological drama scene extending @video1, where @actor1 as Felix loses his footing on a treacherous, wet shale slope, and @actor2 as Samira tries to help him, causing a tense physical reaction.
[[/INTENT]]

[[LOGIC]]
Ensure physical consistency with gravity and momentum during the slip. Maintain spatial tracking of the black trekking pole and the distance between characters. Avoid sudden shifts in rain density or fog level.
[[/LOGIC]]

[[CONTINUITY PROTOCOL]]
Analyze and carry over all visual assets from @video1. Match Felix’s wardrobe and Samira’s wardrobe. Preserve the desaturated slate-gray color palette, diffuse overcast lighting, and wet skin/clothing textures. Keep the handheld, raw documentary-style camera motion consistent with the previous shots.
[[/CONTINUITY PROTOCOL]]

[[AESTHETIC]]
- Sound: No music. Strictly diegetic: clattering of metal poles, sliding scree, heavy rain patter on jackets, sharp chokes, and panicked breathing.
[[/AESTHETIC]]

[[VISUAL BLOCKING]]
The scene opens framing Felix in profile frame-left, turning back, with Samira in soft focus frame-right. The spatial arrangement places Felix uphill, leading the climb on the steep shale slope, with Samira positioned directly behind and slightly lower on the incline.
[[/VISUAL BLOCKING]]
[[/STAGING]]

[<BRIEF>]
[CAM] MS, tracking profile on the axis -> [BLOCK] Felix steps onto loose scree frame-left, his rear foot slipping backward -> [ACT] His body pitches forward, dropping hard to one knee as his trekking pole slips -> [AUDIO] FELIX: "(Sharp, choked gasp) No—!" -> [SFX] Clatter of metal pole against wet stones, sound of sliding rock.
[CAM] Medium shot, low angle looking up-slope -> [BLOCK] Samira lunges forward frame-right to grab his shoulder. Felix violently twists his torso away frame-left -> [ACT] He braces both palms flat against the sharp, wet shale, rejecting her hand -> [AUDIO] FELIX: "(Gasping, voice strained) I've got it. Don't touch me." -> [SFX] Scree shifting under Samira's boots.
[CAM] Close-up, tracking Samira -> [BLOCK] Samira frame-right freezes mid-reach, her arm suspended in the air -> [ACT] She slowly pulls her hand back to her side, her eyes locked onto his trembling shoulders -> [AUDIO] FELIX (O.S.): "(Shaky panting)" -> [SFX] Continuous drizzle on nylon hoods.
[CAM] MCU, low angle -> [BLOCK] Felix frame-left, head hanging low, chest heaving -> [ACT] He tightly grips the black trekking pole, eyes fixed on the wet ground as he prepares to push himself up -> [AUDIO] FELIX: "Just... let me stand up on my own." -> [SFX] Scrape of boot sole against rock.
[</BRIEF>]

---

[[STAGING]]
[[INTENT]]
Create a psychological drama scene extending @video2, featuring @actor1 as Felix and @actor2 as Samira, as Felix struggles to stand up on the steep, rain-slicked mountain trail and admits his crushing exhaustion.
[[/INTENT]]

[[LOGIC]]
Maintain the vertical and horizontal spatial relationship established in @video2, keeping the camera on the right side of the axis. Ensure realistic physical strain and traction loss during Felix’s transition from kneeling to standing.
[[/LOGIC]]

[[CONTINUITY PROTOCOL]]
Analyze and preserve all visual details from @video2. Maintain Felix’s wardrobe and Samira’s wardrobe. Keep the lighting desaturated, cold, and overcast, with persistent dense fog and clinging drizzle. Pacing should remain measured and tense.
[[/CONTINUITY PROTOCOL]]

[[VISUAL BLOCKING]]
The scene opens with Felix kneeling frame-left, bracing himself with his bare left hand on the dark, wet slate, while Samira stands slightly downhill and behind him frame-right. As Felix struggles to his feet, he remains hunched over, creating a high-to-low diagonal line with Samira, who remains stationary.
[[/VISUAL BLOCKING]]
[[/STAGING]]

[<BRIEF>]
[CAM] Low-angle close-up -> [BLOCK] Felix's bare left hand presses hard into the freezing, wet shale frame-left -> [ACT] He grunts, his muddy boots scraping and sliding against the loose scree as he forces his weight upward -> [SFX] Squelch of wet mud, sliding stones, strained grunt.
[CAM] MS, low-angle tracking upward -> [BLOCK] Felix stands up frame-left, keeping his body hunched over, hand braced on his left thigh. Samira stands motionless frame-right -> [ACT] Felix's chest heaves under his wet mustard jacket, his glasses completely fogged over -> [AUDIO] FELIX: "Every morning..." -> [SFX] Laborious, wet breathing.
[CAM] MCU on Felix’s profile -> [BLOCK] Focus on Felix’s face, rain dripping from his beanie and fogged glasses -> [ACT] He squeezes his eyes shut behind the misted lenses, his jaw tensing -> [AUDIO] FELIX: "...I wake up. And the first thing I feel..."
[CAM] OTS over Felix's shoulder -> [BLOCK] Samira in medium focus frame-right, framed against the thick gray fog -> [ACT] She stands still, taking a slow, steady breath, her intense gaze softening into quiet empathy -> [AUDIO] FELIX (O.S.): "...is this... this crushing weight." -> [ENV] Cold breath vaporizing in the air.
[CAM] MCU on Samira -> [BLOCK] Samira centered, framed tightly against the claustrophobic backdrop of mist -> [ACT] She speaks with quiet, steady intensity, her eyes locked on him -> [AUDIO] SAMIRA: "Because you know you have to keep carrying it."
[CAM] WS on Felix -> [BLOCK] Felix frame-left, looking down at his boots -> [ACT] He slowly opens his eyes, staring through the fogged lenses at the gray rocks at his feet, completely spent -> [AUDIO] FELIX: "I don't know how many more steps I have." -> A beat.
[</BRIEF>]

---

[[STAGING]]
[[INTENT]]
Create a cinematic psychological drama scene extending @video3, featuring @actor1 as Felix and @actor2 as Samira, as they resume their agonizing climb up the steep, rain-slicked mountain trail, eventually dissolving entirely into the dense, white fog.
[[/INTENT]]

[[LOGIC]]
Maintain the slow, exhausted tempo of physical movement. Keep the camera on the right side of the main axis established in @video3. Ensure the natural fading of contrast and details as characters walk deeper into the fog. Prioritize facial structure fidelity, ensuring the faces of @actor1 and @actor2 remain sharp, clean with zero morphing or degradation. Maintain perfect facial likeness to the reference images, preventing distorted features.
[[/LOGIC]]

[[CONTINUITY PROTOCOL]]
Analyze and carry over all visual elements from @video3. Maintain Felix’s wardrobe and Samira’s wardrobe. Keep the lighting desaturated, cold, and overcast, matching the skin-clinging drizzle and heavy, shifting mist.
[[/CONTINUITY PROTOCOL]]

[[AESTHETIC]]
- Sound: No music. Diegetic only: scraping metal trekking poles, sliding shale, heavy sighs, and muffled vocal acoustics in deep fog.
[[/AESTHETIC]]

[[VISUAL BLOCKING]]
The scene opens with Felix hunched over frame-left, resting on his knee, while Samira stands slightly below him frame-right on the steep shale incline. As the scene progresses, Felix rises and leads the ascent uphill, with Samira stepping directly into his physical track behind him, both moving away from the lens into the white void.
[[/VISUAL BLOCKING]]
[[/STAGING]]

[<BRIEF>]
[CAM] Close-up, tracking low-angle -> [BLOCK] Felix is frame-left, hunched over -> [ACT] He lets out a long, shuddering sigh, lifts his black trekking pole, and plants it forward -> [AUDIO] [SFX] Loud, scraping metallic clink on wet slate.
[CAM] Medium shot -> [BLOCK] Felix frame-left starts to drag his boot uphill; Samira stands frame-right -> [ACT] Samira waits one beat, then steps directly into his path behind him -> [AUDIO] [SFX] Boots crunching softly in loose stones.
[CAM] OTS over Samira's shoulder -> [BLOCK] Felix is uphill in midground, slowly climbing, Samira close behind -> [ACT] Felix climbs with agonizing slowness, head down -> [AUDIO] FELIX: "I keep waiting... for the slope to finally level out." -> [ENV] Dense white fog rolling across the screen.
[CAM] Side-angle MS, tracking -> [BLOCK] Felix leads frame-left, his shape softening in the fog; Samira follows frame-right -> [ACT] He takes another dragging step as the mist thickens around them -> [AUDIO] FELIX: "But it just keeps going." -> [SFX] Wind rustling wet nylon.
[CAM] WS, low-angle -> [BLOCK] Both characters are now centered, moving away from camera uphill -> [ACT] Their silhouettes start to fade into the dense white mist -> [ENV] Rolling fog obscuring their shapes.
[CAM] WS, slow pull out -> [BLOCK] The camera moves backward, away from the slope -> [ACT] Felix and Samira dissolve entirely into the blank white void of the fog -> [AUDIO] FELIX (O.S.): "(Muffled, distant) Into nothing."
[CAM] Continue, WS, slow pull out
[</BRIEF>]
